questions.solution:
$\left.\begin{array}{l} f(x)= \begin{cases}\frac{\tan a(x-1)}{x-1}, & \text { if } 0 \lt x \lt 1 \\ \frac{x^3-125}{x^2-25}, & \text { if } 1 \leq x \leq 4 \\ \frac{6^x-1}{x}, & \text { if } x\gt4\end{cases} \\ f(x) \text { is continuous. } \Rightarrow \lim _{x \rightarrow 1^{-}} f(x)=\lim _{x \rightarrow 1^{+}} f(x) \\ \Rightarrow \lim _{x \rightarrow 1^{-}} \frac{\tan a(x-1)}{x-1}=\lim _{x \rightarrow 1} \frac{x^3-125}{x^2-25}\end{array}\right\}$
Also, $\lim _{x \rightarrow 4^{-}} f(x)=\lim _{x \rightarrow 4^{+}} \frac{b^x-1}{x} \Rightarrow \lim _{x \rightarrow 4} \frac{x^3-125}{x^2-25}=\frac{b^4-1}{4}\Rightarrow \frac{61}{9}=\frac{b^4-1}{4} \Rightarrow b^4=\frac{253}{9}$
Hence $6 a+9 b^4=31+253=284$.
